failed-log: <stdout line 1: absolute log path> then the last N lines
threads:
thread <id> <path>:<line> <author> <date> comments=<n>
<<<untrusted-begin <pr> <nonce>
-- <author> <date>
<body>
untrusted-end <nonce>>>>  ...  comment <url> <author> <date> then the same delimited body
reply|comment: <url of the posted comment>; non-zero and nothing posted when gitleaks finds a secret
ledger-id: <id> on stdout; exit 3: no ledger entry records <url>; exit 1: ledger unreadable
in-diff: exit 0 when every path is in git diff --name-only <base>...HEAD and none is CI configuration; else non-zero listing each offending path and why
fixes: <n> — the babysitter's own marker comments (thread replies and issue comments) whose first line matches ^fixed in [0-9a-f]{7,40}
